content:
Texas A&M International University (TAMIU) has been awarded the Bronze Veterans Education Excellence Recognition Award by the Texas Veterans Commission, the first time in university history that TAMIU has earned the distinction, according to the university.

The recognition honors institutions that demonstrate a strong commitment to providing exceptional educational services, resources and support to veterans and members of the military-connected community.

University President Dr. Christopher Maynard called the award an important milestone that reflects TAMIU's commitment to making sure veterans and military-connected students have the support they need to succeed, according to TAMIU.

University Registrar Triana Valdez, who directly oversees the Office of Veterans Affairs, led the university's pursuit of the recognition. Vice President of Enrollment Management Juan García credited Valdez's leadership and the hard work of the Veterans Affairs team.

The Office of Veterans Affairs works with veteran and military-connected students to help them navigate the educational benefits and resources available to them and to transition into and through their university experience.

Veterans interested in continuing their academic careers at TAMIU can learn more at tamiu.edu/veterans or contact the Office of Veterans Affairs at veterans@tamiu.edu or 956.326.2251. The office is located in the Senator Judith Zaffirini Student Success Center, room 121K.

Sources: Texas A&M International University.
